title: Section C SC-05: factory events are processed at the chain head with no reorg handling

evidence.note: HTTP poll: queries lastBlock+1..head and sets lastBlock = head, no confirmation depth, no overlap rescan
WS listener: dispatches on every event with no removed-log check

sibling_sites_checked: Both pollers and both WS listeners checked; no use of confirmations, removed logs or block hashes anywhere in the slice (C08 search).
severity_rationale: S3: a PairCreated from a block that is reorged out triggers a buy that then fails (the strategies simulate first), and an event re-included in a later block below lastBlock is never seen by the HTTP poller. Missed or wasted opportunities, no capital path.
recommendation: Decide on card BUY-08 whether to keep head processing for speed and add an overlap rescan, or wait for confirmations.
